test_title: PYST 26: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - General Awareness (Held On: 20th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: PM eVIDYA mainly aims to improve:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Digital learning**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• PM eVIDYA is a comprehensive initiative launched by the Government of India in May 2020 under the Atma Nirbhar Bharat Abhiyan (Self-Reliant India Campaign).
 
• The primary objective of PM eVIDYA is to enhance access to digital learning resources and ensure the continuity of education during the COVID-19 pandemic and beyond.
 
• This initiative integrates all efforts related to digital/online/on-air education, making it a unified platform for digital learning in India.
 
• Key components of PM eVIDYA include DIKSHA (Digital Infrastructure for Knowledge Sharing), SWAYAM (Study Webs of Active Learning for Young Aspiring Minds), SWAYAM PRABHA TV channels, and radio podcasts for educational purposes.
 
• The initiative also caters to students with special needs through the development of e-content in sign language and accessible formats.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sanitation**:

 
 
• Sanitation refers to the provision of facilities and services for the safe disposal of human waste (urine and feces) to maintain hygiene and health.
 
• The Swachh Bharat Abhiyan (Clean India Mission) is the flagship initiative of the Indian government aimed at improving sanitation and eliminating open defecation.
 
• While sanitation is a crucial public health concern, it is not the focus of PM eVIDYA.
 
 
 
• **Infrastructure**:
 
 
• Infrastructure refers to the basic physical structures and facilities (e.g., buildings, roads, power supplies) required for the operation of a society or enterprise.
 
• Government programs like the National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP) focus on enhancing infrastructure development in India.
 
• However, PM eVIDYA is dedicated to digital learning and does not directly address infrastructure development.
 
 
 
• **Logistics**:
 
 
• Logistics involves the planning, implementation, and coordination of the movement and storage of goods, services, and information within a supply chain.
 
• Government initiatives like the National Logistics Policy aim to improve the efficiency of India’s logistics sector.
 
• Logistics is unrelated to the objectives of PM eVIDYA, which focuses on educational resources and digital learning.
